data.description: Front-end development for the My Account area of El Corte Inglés' ecommerce (Vue, SSR and accessibility). I also designed and evolved the agentic harness that the development team uses daily: an orchestrator with specialised subagents and skills in GitHub Copilot CLI on OpenAI and Anthropic models, covering the full cycle from user story to PR, with human approval and optimised for token spend management.

data.position: Senior Front-End Developer at NyxellApp S.L.
data.description: I led the development of the back-office for a nightlife ticketing marketplace (events, venues and customer management), including the migration from Vue 2 to Vue 3, with a focus on improving the interface and usability. Vue, Sass, Node.js, Vite and AWS Amplify.

data.position: Agile Front-End Developer at Trackglobe S.L.
data.description: Development and maintenance of custom modules with Vue and Sass within a .NET MVC platform on Azure, and integration of HTML5, Sass and JavaScript mock-ups into the group's projects.
Custom software development with C#, .NET MVC and MySQL, including database schema design and maintenance, and research into Microsoft mobile solutions on Office 365 (PowerApps).
Hardware assembly and maintenance, backups and technical support at a HiperCor store (El Corte Inglés Group). My first professional experience and the foundation of how I solve problems.

ai.title: How I work with AI
ai.subtitle: I don't use AI as an autocomplete. I design agent systems with rules, subagents and human checkpoints, and tune them to perform well without blowing up token spend.

steps.title: Request
steps.description: A user story, a bug or an idea.

steps.title: Orchestrator
steps.description: Understands the task and delegates the work to specialised subagents.

steps.title: Subagents
steps.description: Exploration, implementation, review and in-browser validation.

steps.title: Human approval
steps.description: Nothing is implemented or published without review and sign-off.

steps.title: Pull Request
steps.description: Validated, reviewed and ready to merge.

principles.title: Context window
principles.description: Each subagent returns only its conclusions and context is loaded on demand, so the main session never gets overloaded.

principles.title: Token spend
principles.description: The right model and effort for each task, and no delegating the trivial: every call has to earn its keep.

principles.title: Skills and MCP
principles.description: Reusable procedures and connections to different platforms, loaded only when needed.

principles.title: Specs and control
principles.description: Significant changes are agreed upfront with specs, and sensitive actions always ask for permission.

principles.title: Parallel work
principles.description: Each feature in its own worktree and branch, so several terminals with agents can run at once without stepping on each other.

team.title: My Account harness · El Corte Inglés
team.description: The agentic system the development team uses every day. I designed it and have evolved it based on how it is used: every subagent, skill and rule exists because it solved a real problem for the team.
team.note: Internal tool: the code is not public.

personal.title: Personal harness (jdev-ai)
personal.description: My personal harness for working with several agents across independent projects: subagents, per-project memory and history, worktrees and specs. I built Fitnessia and Balanz.io with it.

aboutMe.title: About me
aboutMe.lead: I'm a front-end developer with a passion for product: understanding the people who use it and caring about every detail of the experience.
paragraphs: Today AI is at the heart of how I work: I design agentic harnesses for teams, orchestrate subagents, look after the context window and token costs, and closely follow every new model and tool to keep what truly works.

With Andalusian roots, I was born in Jerez and grew up in Seville, which I visit less often than I'd like. I currently live in Valencia with my partner, and wherever I go, my laptop always comes with me.

Ever since I was a child I've been fascinated by any device with a screen, a curiosity that over time became a vocation and then my professional career. Today I have the privilege of doing what I love most: building digital experiences and bringing ideas to life through code.
